description: This is a C source file implementing an Ethernet driver for Silicon Labs EFM32 Giant Gecko 11 microcontroller within the Zephyr RTOS. It includes initialization, buffer management, interrupt handling, and PHY configuration for Ethernet communication.

methods.name: link_configure
methods.description: Configures Ethernet link parameters such as duplex mode and speed.

methods.name: eth_gecko_setup_mac
methods.description: Sets up MAC link parameters based on PHY auto-negotiation results.

methods.name: rx_error_handler
methods.description: Handles reception errors by resetting RX buffers.

methods.name: frame_get
methods.description: Retrieves a complete Ethernet frame from RX buffers.

methods.name: rx_thread
methods.description: Thread function for polling link status and processing received data.

methods.name: eth_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine handling Ethernet-related interrupts.

methods.name: eth_init_clocks
methods.description: Enables necessary clocks for Ethernet operation.

methods.name: eth_init_pins
methods.description: Configures GPIO pins for Ethernet interface.

methods.name: eth_init
methods.description: Initializes Ethernet device, including clocks, pins, PHY, and DMA buffers.

methods.name: generate_mac
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a MAC address for the device.

methods.name: eth_iface_init
methods.description: Initializes network interface, sets MAC address, and configures hardware.

methods.name: eth_gecko_get_capabilities
methods.description: Returns the capabilities of the Ethernet hardware.
